no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA/product was not taken to an Advisory Committee

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the Altabax (retapamulin) NDA022055 approval. The Administrative Correspondence review states the product was not taken to an Advisory Committee (L371), and the Medical Review's section 8.5 'Advisory Committee Meeting' records it as 'Not applicable' (L790). With no AC meeting, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
